lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Good Samaritan Law & Responsibilities at Crash Scenes
prompt: How does the Texas Good Samaritan Law protect citizens who administer emergency first aid at crash scenes?

options.text: Compensates rescuers with cash payments from state treasury emergency funds
Provides automatic immunity from all future state moving traffic violations
Shields citizens from civil damages for emergency care rendered in good faith
Authorizes untrained citizens to perform complex field surgical operations
